name: 鵲鴨

iucn.assessmentNote: IUCN全球無危；香港屬偶見記錄

illustrationTaxon: Bucephala clangula adult male breeding plumage; separately sourced and labelled same-species female feature

similarSpecies.distinction: 冰島鵲鴨雄鳥眼前白斑呈新月形；鵲鴨雄鳥白斑為圓形或橢圓形。冰島鵲鴨另有白脅黑色側突。此北美近似種比較不代表香港出現。
白秋沙鴨雄鳥頭身大致白色、具明顯黑色眼罩及黑紋；鵲鴨雄鳥為綠黑頭、圓白頰斑及白頸黑背。

featureNotes: 綠光深色頭部近短喙有圓形白斑；不是冰島鵲鴨新月斑
鵲鴨成鳥虹膜呈淡金黃色
雄鳥折翼有大型白色翼斑，飛行時白翼區更明顯
同種雌鳥：褐色頭、灰色胸脅及白腹；不是另一物種

sources.use: Full HKBWS species account read: Category I accidental in Hong Kong; 40–50 cm; male has a large domed head, short bill, pale yellow eye, green-glossed dark head with distinctive oval white spot at bill base, white neck/chest/flanks, dark upperparts/tail and large white wing area; female brown-headed, grey-chested/flanked, brown upperparts/tail; records include one female at Mai Po in 1981–82 and five at Plover Cove in 1997; global IUCN LC, stable.

Cornell Lab comparison read: adult male Barrow's Goldeneye has a crescent-shaped facial patch versus the round patch of Common Goldeneye; Barrow's also has a dark side spur. Used as a clearly labelled North American comparison, not a Hong Kong occurrence claim.

Full HKBWS Smew account read: adult male breeding plumage has white head/body and obvious black mask; female or immature has rufous crown/hindneck and grey body; rare winter visitor in Hong Kong, with global IUCN LC. Used as a distinct named male comparison.
